integrity: The source estimator definitions were inspected directly. The bias, finite-population sampling variance, interpolation MSE, and threshold formulas are derived algebraically. An exact-rational exhaustive enumeration independently checks the identities on a nontrivial vector population.
scientific_limitations: The result is a conditional one-iterate estimator theorem. It does not establish convergence of the biased or partially debiased optimization method, and the oracle MSE-optimal interpolation depends on unknown persistent-versus-complement contrast and complement dispersion.
title: Exact bias-variance frontier for debiasing persistent mini-batch gradients
